title: Multiple myeloma extraction trade-off plots
description: Turn a 12-row agent+model evaluation matrix (scored against a ClinicalTrials.gov extraction benchmark) into five decision-relevant charts — accuracy, speed-vs-completeness, cost per correct result, agent reliability, and throughput — each answering a distinct question, with a validated colorblind-safe palette and a hard no-overlapping-labels gate.

cta.label: Fork and run
cta.note: Runs on Jetty's managed sandbox. No setup. Free for your first 10 runs.

inputs.label: Evaluation matrix
inputs.description: CSV, one row per agent+model combination, columns: agent, model, status, gold_total, num_found, num_missing, recall_pct, num_extra_entries, precision_pct, title_accuracy_pct, url_accuracy_pct, status_accuracy_pct, enrollment_accuracy_pct, study_type_accuracy_pct, start_date_accuracy_pct, overall_field_accuracy_pct, cost_usd, total_tokens, duration_seconds, notes.

metrics._note: Live counters — supplied by the Jetty backend at render time, not authored here.

caveats: This is a purpose-built visualization runbook for a specific evaluation matrix schema — the 20-column CSV format (agent, model, status, recall_pct, overall_field_accuracy_pct, cost_usd, duration_seconds, etc.) is not generic; a differently-shaped evaluation CSV would need the column names in Step 3 adjusted.

The runbook's frontmatter mentions a prior failed attempt that shipped overlapping labels despite calling adjustText — Step 4 now includes a mandatory programmatic overlap-check gate (asserting zero overlapping label bounding boxes) before a chart is accepted, per this runbook's own Common Fixes / Step 6 iteration loop.
